//: WHERE THE WORD IS NOT THE PLUGIN. Three of this package's files spell another row's name as ordinary code, and each is recorded here rather than excused by a pattern — the equality in @olai/bundle's fence.test.ts is what refuses a NEW collision until somebody writes it down with a reason. 'search' is `url.searchParams`, which every one of the three files uses because they all compose or parse a request; 'git' is the `git:` line of the version string the fake binary prints, which the pinned Himalaya really does print (`himalaya --version` ends with two lines about the build and its revision) and which the fake must reproduce or the surface check's parse is exercised over a string no binary would answer.
